importDialog.roomsDescription: Put the template Excel file and images in a folder named dulieuphong, then zip it as dulieuphong.zip. Images are uploaded directly to Cloudinary before room data is sent to the server.
importDialog.roomInstructionsTypes: In Excel, select room type, building, and status from the dropdown lists. Enter the integer floorNumber in the Floor column; the system uses the floor number and building to find the correct floor. Enter amenity IDs in one cell, separated by semicolons (;); find IDs and names in the Catalog sheet. Only IDs in the catalog are accepted. Room numbers must be positive integers.
importDialog.roomInstructionsBeds: In the Room Beds sheet, select the room number and bed type from the dropdown lists, then enter a quantity of at least 1. A room can have multiple bed types by adding multiple rows for the same room number; each room needs at least one bed configuration row.
importDialog.roomInstructionsImages: Each room needs 4 to 8 images, up to 5 MB per image. Enter image filenames in the Image 1–Image 8 columns; names must match files in the images folder, including extensions (for example, 101-1.jpg). Each row represents one room. Do not rename the columns.
importDialog.roomInstructionsArchive: Place phong.xlsx and the images folder side by side inside dulieuphong, then zip the dulieuphong folder as dulieuphong.zip. The frontend uploads images directly to Cloudinary using an unsigned upload preset; the server receives image URLs and saves the rooms.
